Preserve the character's green sprout hairstyle, head/body proportions, gentle youthful face, three-quarter left orientation, selected ivory-green leaf-shoulder dress, modest coverage, sachet, shoes, standing stance and all other design details. Same clean project icon painting, bold organic dark outline, few broad matte light/shadow planes, no glassy reflections or noisy facets. Whole figure and enlarged gourd safely inside the same square warm-ivory canvas. No text, added effects, extra objects or crop.
